title: TSTM Sequence Corpus Record
description: One row per generated abstract security-transition sequence, per Agent 3 Section 16 / Agent 4 Section 16. Frozen prior to execution; must not be altered after results are observed.

sequence_id.description: Stable, unique, content-derived ID (e.g. hash of transition trace) so the same sequence always gets the same ID.

family.description: F8 is intentionally excluded (Agent 3 Section 5: subsumed, not a distinct family).

origin.description: TSTM_GENERATED = produced by the bounded generator (Agent 4 Section 10). BASELINE_MAPPED = an existing tuf-conformance test case re-expressed in this schema (Agent 4 Section 12). Required to keep the two populations distinguishable for the coverage-delta calculation.

parameters.description: Concrete instantiation within the frozen finite domains (Agent 4 Section 6). Free-form but must only use frozen domain values -- validated separately, not by this schema alone.

counts_toward_k.description: False only for the bootstrap/setup step (Agent 4 Section 8: bootstrap is excluded from K).

length.description: Number of steps with counts_toward_k == true. Must be <=4 for CORE families (F1,F3,F4,F5) and <=6 for SECONDARY (F2,F6,F7).

initial_state.description: Frozen finite-domain abstract state (Agent 3 Section 3 / Agent 4 Section 6).

expected_state_trace.description: One abstract state snapshot per step, deterministically derived from the oracle -- never inferred from observed execution.

oracle_properties.description: Which normative properties this sequence is designed to exercise (Agent 3 Section 7). A property counts as 'exercised' for C4 only if this sequence actually reaches the property's precondition -- checked at generation time, not asserted here.

c2_pairs.description: Ordered adjacent transition-type pairs contributed by this sequence, for C2 accumulation.

c3_triples.description: Ordered adjacent transition-type triples, CORE-family-restricted (Agent 3 Section 10 / Agent 4 Section 16).

boundary_states.description: Which frozen boundary conditions (Agent 4 Section 6/18) this sequence instantiates, for C5.
